17 | Unpresence | caster | C | self | E

19 | Disguise V | caster | 10 min/lvl | self | U
20 | Misfeel | caster | C | self | E
25 | Nondetect | caster | C | self | E

50 | Disguise Mastery | caster | varies | self | U

# Descriptions
@@ 1
Caster studies a person for use with disguise spells later on this list. The
caster can only have as many disguises studied as he has levels.
@@ 2
Changes the visual appearance of one object. The target of the spell must be
no larger than 10 pounds per level of the caster.
@@ 3
Caster has a limited illusion on himself that allows him to look like any
humanoid race within 20% of his own size. The illusion moves as the caster
moves.
@@ 4
All deeds performed (while this spell is active) are “shadowed” to divination
spells. For the purposes of a divination spell, the information gained about
the caster will be shrouded in shadows. For example, a Death’s Memory cast on
the scene of a murder might reveal a shadowy figure performing the deeds (but
no details about the identity of the figure).
@@ 5
For the purposes of mental or magical detections, the caster appears to be of
any race he chooses (racial type must be selected at the time of casting).
@@ 6
As Facade I, except one extra sense is added.
@@ 7
Caster physically changes to take on the form and visual appearance of any one
studied person. This is strictly a physical change. The cster must already
have cast a Study Disguise on this person.
@@ 8
As Shadow Assassin, except absolutely no information about the caster will be
revealed. For example, a Death’s Memory cast on the scen of a murder might
show the victim collapsing with a knife in his chest (but no sign of the
assassin).
@@ 9
As Facade I, except two extra senses are added.
@@ 10
As Disguise I, except caster also takes on the vocal characteristics (i.e., he
sounds like the person).
@@ 11
As Misfeel Kind, except caster appears to be of any profession he chooses.
@@ 12
aster may mentally speak with one target; to the target it will seem as if
they are communicating normally (i.e., verbally).
@@ 13
As Disguise II, except caster also takes on the obvious mannerisms of the
person. For example, if the person was left-handed, the caster is left-handed;
if the person has a limp, the caster will have a limp.
@@ 14
As Facade I, except all senses are included.
@@ 15
As Misfeel Kind, except caster appears to be of any level he chooses (ranging
from first level to twice his actual level).
@@ 16
As Disguise III, except caster also takes on subtle mannerisms of the person.
This makes him virtually undetectable to all but the closest of associates.
@@ 17
As Misfeel Kind, except caster appears to have no presence (for presence
detecting spells).
@@ 18
As Shadow Assassin, except all deeds performed while this spell is active will
appear as if the currently studied patsy is performing them (see Study Patsy
on Assassination Mastery).
@@ 19
As Disguise IV, except even very subtle mannerisms are gained.
@@ 20
As all of the Misfeel spells on this list at the same time.
@@ 25
Caster and objects on his person cannot be detected by any Detect... spells.
@@ 30
As Misfeel, except caster need not concentrate.
@@ 50
Caster may use any lower level spell on this list, one per round.
